name: Low-Carbon Ferro-Chrome (LC FeCr)
description: Crucial for stainless and heat resistant steels with strict carbon ceiling.

name: High-Carbon Ferro-Chrome (HC FeCr)
description: Economical chromium source for high carbon tool steels and wear alloys.

name: High-Carbon Ferro-Manganese (HC FeMn)
description: Standard manganese deoxidizer and alloying agent.

name: Pure Electrolytic Nickel Briquettes / Cathodes
description: Essential for austenitic stainless, duplex, and nickel superalloys.

name: Ferro-Molybdenum (FeMo 60)
description: High-density molybdenum addition for pitting resistance and high-temp strength.

name: Ferro-Vanadium (FeV 80)
description: Grain refiner and carbide former for high strength and tool steels.

name: Ferro-Niobium (FeNb 65)
description: Stabilizing element against intergranular corrosion (AISI 347, Inconel 718).

name: Ferro-Titanium (FeTi 70)
description: Stabilizing element and grain refiner (AISI 321, 316Ti). Highly reactive.

name: Ferro-Tungsten (FeW 75)
description: Essential hot-hardness carbide former for High Speed Steels (HSS T and M series).

name: Pure Copper Scrap / Cathode (Cu 99.9)
description: Corrosion resistance enhancer for 904L, 204Cu, precipitation hardening 17-4PH.

name: Pure Aluminum Notch Bar (Al 99.7)
description: Deoxidation and precipitation hardening agent (17-7PH, Nitriding steels).

name: Recarburizer (Graphite Granules)
description: Pure carbon addition for carbon adjustment.

name: Ultra-Low Carbon Mild Steel Scrap / Iron
description: Used as dilution base to reduce excess concentration of unwanted elements.

name: Nitrided Ferro-Chrome
description: Nitrogen alloying for austenitic & duplex steels without gas porosity.
